remaining: chooses replacement operation with current claim and revision
valid JSON summary/replacements with self-contained remaining tasks and continue_with key
correction: chooses edit with claim and revision
identity: new returned task ID and fresh claim with continue_with; no reuse of old token
outcome: dependent waits and supervisor unresolved until all branches complete
original remains historical replaced state; does not become completed
discovered: newly discovered necessary work may be represented by successors
does not discard implementation; record completed work and relevant paths in summary
stale_owner: stale token cannot mutate or evolve; authorship grants no override
read current state and coordinate rather than steal current claim
handoff: omit continue_with; all pending; inherit tags/metadata/prereqs/scratch
old notes stay on predecessor; new briefs carry necessary context and acceptance
navigation: history or parent_id/origin_id; note body only explicit read
finished: record actual result and verification; no empty replacement plan
